snippet.title: The Toon Resistance Needs YOU!
snippet.description:
This training film from the Toon Resistance Archives follows Ripley, a plucky new recruit who wants to join the Toon Resistance and fight back against those dastardly Cogs. By following these steps, you too can join Ripley in becoming a member of the Toon Resistance:

1. Complete all ToonTasks through Donald's Dreamland.
2. Earn each of the Cog Disguises (Sellbot, Cashbot, Lawbot, and Bossbot).
3. Have at least one Level 7 gag on hand -- you'll need it!

Once you've completed these steps, the Toon Resistance may just find YOU very soon...

Toons of the world, UNITE!

---
